exposure: hospital setting (urban nonteaching, rural-setting, urban teaching)
outcome: annual number of obstetric care-providing hospitals
cohort: The study included more than 4,500 hospitals identified in the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality's Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project National Inpatient Sample.
finding: The annual number of obstetric care-providing hospitals in the United States decreased by 8.0% from 2016 to 2022, with more pronounced decreases in the Midwest and West regions and in urban nonteaching and rural-setting hospitals.
cross-section timing: Annual cross-sections taken over the 7-year period from 2016 to 2022.
